author: ilariad239

title: Fantastic guide and driver
text: We had the most wonderful day,  with Jan and Manuel,  who took us through every experience with great care to every detail...Manuel has an amazing knowledge of every where we visited and made our trip very memorable.  Very considerate too of my limited mobility. I could not praise them enough  , we were so thankful.
author: hazelsE5823AR

title: Jerez-Cadiz desde Sevilla
text: Really nice trip. The guide and driver were super friendly and helpful. To improve even further the tour, my sugestion is to include a mini-tour/explanation while in Cadiz, since the historical center is quite small.
author: TatiDAB

title: Touring the city of Cadiz
text: The tour included a tour of the city of Jerez and Cadiz. We went on a visit to a winery with historical explanations and wine making as well as tasting. Very clear and extensive explanation. The rest of the day we visited the beautiful city of Cadiz with a very good explanation from the guide. I think the time was somewhat short so the walk is somewhat tired. Very grateful for our guide. The tour is worth it.
author: I9758KJalejandroc

title: Excellent
text: Visiting the Alhambra was a Dream come true. Soraida was very friendly , full of energy and Knowledgeable. She was excellent . Our guide in the Alhambra was patient, and  Knowledgeable. Really could not have asked for more. Thank you .
author: Jairo_R

title: Nice …but !
text: Very good day out with just a few issues. The guide was difficult to understand as his English although very good was still hard to make out. (It wasn’t just me) as others were also looking confused. Also, he liked to get across his political views which annoyed us. Leave politics out of holidays.
author: garyaF3371GP

title: Full Day; Lots to See; Multi-lingual
text: It was a great tour, and we had a very good first look at Jerez and Cadiz.   The tour company had to be nimble because there was a road race in town and many streets were blocked, so the logistics were not  usual.    Antonio is very knowledgable and is a character, and tells many fun stories (to be taken with a grain of salt).  There is a lot packed into a one day tour,  so you move along.    The tour group almost filled a big bus,  and Antonio make his remarks in three different languages (Spanish, English, French),  so bravo to Antonio for his language skills, but there was some dead time as
author: FredF555
